name: Redmine Manager
description: Create, read, update, delete, and list Redmine issues, and look up project/tracker/status/priority IDs. Use for QC bug tracking: log a bug, check issue status, add a comment, change status, or find valid IDs before creating an issue.
author: nus

input.hint: Base URL of your Redmine instance, no trailing slash
Redmine My account > API access key

examples.prompt: [REDMINE:CREATE] project_id=qc-app subject="Login button không hoạt động trên Safari" description="Click nút Login không có phản hồi trên Safari 17." tracker_id=1
examples.call: {"action": "create", "project_id": "qc-app", "subject": "Login button không hoạt động trên Safari", "description": "Click nút Login không có phản hồi trên Safari 17.", "tracker_id": 1}

examples.prompt: [REDMINE:UPDATE] issue_id=123 status_id=3 notes="Đã fix, chờ QA verify."

action.description: Operation to perform: create, read, update, delete, list, meta, or help

issue_id.description: Redmine issue ID. Required for read, update, delete.

project_id.description: Project identifier (slug) or numeric ID. Required for create. Optional filter for list.

description.description: Issue description text. Used on create; ignored on update (use notes instead).

tracker_id.description: Tracker ID (e.g. Bug/Feature/Task). Look up via action=meta, meta_type=trackers.

priority_id.description: Priority ID. Look up via action=meta, meta_type=priorities.

status_id.description: Status ID to set on update, or to filter by on list. Look up via action=meta, meta_type=statuses.

assigned_to_id.description: Redmine user ID to assign the issue to.

notes.description: Comment text to add. Used on update to log a note/comment (visible in issue journal).

limit.description: Max number of results for list action. Default 25.

meta_type.description: For action=meta: one of projects, trackers, statuses, priorities.
